verdict.rationale: Apple's own materials credit M4 Pro with power efficiency and list long battery-life figures for the laptops it ships in (up to 22 hours of video streaming, and up to 24 hours for the MacBook Pro M4 family). Nothing shows fanless designs, quiet operation, or thinness, and the battery figures are vendor-only with no independent testing. missing for 10: evidence of fanless or quiet designs, evidence of thin form factors, independent or hands-on battery-life corroboration, battery figures clearly attributed to M4 Pro configurations.

support.subject: As a power-user, this chip powers thin, quiet, all-day-battery machines — shipping in fanless or low-power designs with credible battery-life evidence

citations.quote: M4 Pro offers stunning performance and Apple silicon’s legendary power efficiency
users get up to 24 hours of battery life, raising the bar of what users can do on a single charge
